environment.isolation: PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED transactions with per-schema advisory migration locks and per-origin stream row locks

claims.property: migration jobs serialize per schema, upgrade version 1 data, and retry without reapplying migrations
evidence: two migration connections raced from an empty schema and applied versions (1, 2) exactly once
a version-1 observation received a stable receipt during version-2 backfill
a third migration returned no applied versions

claims.property: an exact retry after an unobserved response returns one stable receipt while changed content conflicts
evidence: two runtime connections submitted the same origin record concurrently
both responses had one receipt ID and exactly one was marked duplicate
same tuple with a changed canonical record hash raised IngestConflictError

claims.property: a missing origin sequence admits no later observation and exposes the next expected sequence
evidence: sequence 3 after sequence 1 raised IngestGapError(expected=2, received=3)
stream status remained at next_expected_seq=2 before sequence 2 was admitted

claims.property: runtime and migration principals are separated at both database privilege and compatibility boundaries
evidence: runtime CREATE TABLE in the audit schema failed with PostgreSQL InsufficientPrivilege
the migration role returned role_kind_mismatch and could not call ingest_observation through the runtime gate
runtime-role rotation revoked schema usage from the previous principal before the replacement passed compatibility

claims.property: environment schemas retain independent observation histories and bounded reads use ingest offsets
evidence: the same producer record admitted to two schemas received different receipt IDs and independent duplicate counts
offset-ordered reads returned two observations and limit 101 was rejected

claims.property: local SQLite and NDJSON capture/rebuild semantics remain unchanged
evidence: the complete 51-test suite passed, including dual-write, crash convergence, rebuild, CLI, and publisher tests
the served central modules are not imported by auditctl CLI startup

notes: The PostgreSQL instance was created under /tmp and stopped and removed by the test fixture; no shared or production database was addressed.
The first harness runs exposed Nix initdb/postgres share-path resolution and were repaired by invoking resolved store binaries.
HTTP/catalog behaviour, appservice Jobs, backup/restore, and cross-machine tests remain deferred to owner-local follow-up items.
implementation_sha identifies the governed base plus the item-1201 working tree because this result is committed atomically with the implementation.
